NOTE: Full Stripe UI E2E for family_sentinel was NOT attempted this iteration (would require headed browser + manual card entry twice). Backend activation path is proven via direct _activate_tier() invocation on a seeded unpaid tx which is the exact same code Stripe webhook + /billing/status call — behaviour identical.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/billing.py (269 lines, within limit): _issue_receipt is wrapped in try/except so a storage/PDF failure NEVER breaks payment fulfilment (payment_transactions row remains processed:true). ✓

routes/billing.py._activate_tier for family_sentinel uses TWO update_one calls — one with {inner_circle:{$ne:True}, tier:{$ne:'archangel'}} guard for the payer (non-destructive), then unconditionally sets family_pack_owner=True. This is correct: an Archangel/Inner-Circle payer still becomes the family_pack owner without losing their higher tier. ✓

Guardian upgrade uses update_many with same guard clause — correctly excludes archangel & inner_circle members from downgrade. Verified by test test_receipt_and_family_activation (g3 archangel stays archangel).
family_members_activated is recorded from upd.modified_count — accurate count (2/3 in test).

routes/subscription.py.cancel: sets tier_until:None, tier_paid_with:None, tier_billing:None, family_pack_owner:False in one $set. Inner-circle 400 comes BEFORE the sovereign-check 409, so founder gets the specific 400 message (verified). ✓

routes/billing.py.billing_gift: strips + lowercases email, clamps days 1..3650, refetches user's is_founder from DB (not from cached token payload) — resistant to a stale token from a demoted founder. Correctly blocks gifting to inner_circle recipients with 409. ✓ Push notification wrapped in try/except so a push failure does not fail the gift. ✓

subscription.tsx (410 lines, borderline — still within 700-line rule): cancelConfirm two-step is a plain state boolean (no modal), reset after successful cancel. cardCheckout branches web (window.location.assign) vs native (WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync) — matches Stripe expected behaviour. Gift/founder blocks gated behind `founder` state which is populated only if GET /wealth/founder-dashboard succeeds (403 for non-founders → founder=null → sections hidden). ✓ pollPayment uses same 12×2s loop for family_sentinel; label reads 'SENTINEL (RODINNÝ BALÍK)' after paid. ✓

Founder smoketest-user-1 untouched. Two residual family_sentinel initiated (unpaid) payment_transactions rows exist from checkout tests (non-processed, harmless — will show as 'initiated' in tx list but never activated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL=EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (public ingress). Founder token=smoketok-fresh-2026 (smoketest-user-1, is_founder+inner_circle+archangel — untouchable). Idempotency guard find_one_and_update({processed:{$ne:true}}) prevents double activation. Frontend gift box + founder admin box are gated behind a successful GET /wealth/founder-dashboard call (any non-2xx → sections hidden). If a full family_sentinel Stripe UI E2E is required in future, seed a fresh sovereign user via _make_user() pattern, drive the checkout URL in a headed browser, pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242, and expect same-tab redirect back to /subscription?session_id=… → pollPayment loop → SENTINEL (RODINNÝ BALÍK) label.
